title: Waiting gates take a free slot in no order
what: Gates waiting for a gate slot take a freed slot in arrival order, so the gate that waited longest runs first.
why: 29 Oct: a gate waiting since 01:29 (pid 9401) was passed by one started at 01:41 (10491), which got a slot first; with 2 slots and up to 6 lanes a gate can wait for hours. Found by the slow-gates diagnosis. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: 29 Oct 01:29 and 01:41: two gates waited on the same 2 slots and the later one ran first.
pass_cases: Two gates waiting for one slot: the one that started waiting first gets it.
